## Pre-launch Checklist

- [ ] I read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/jonataslaw/getx/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I updated the relevant API documentation and English README, or explained why no documentation changes are needed.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests, or explained why tests do not apply (maintainers decide test exemptions).
- [ ] I reported the checks I actually ran and their results, including any failures or checks still pending.
- [ ] I described compatibility implications and migration steps for any breaking changes, or stated that there are none.
- [ ] If I used AI tools, I read the [AI contribution guidelines](https://github.com/jonataslaw/getx/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.ai.md), personally reviewed and understand the changes, and verified the accuracy of the description and reported test results; otherwise, I did not use AI tools.
